parts.meaning_en: full of, having the quality of

analysis: 源自拉丁语 ambiguus：ambi-（两边）+ agere（驱动），字面义为“被推向两边的”，故引申为“模棱两可的、含糊不清的”。

meanings.meaning_en: open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning
meanings.meaning_zh: 模棱两可的，含糊不清的
examples: His reply was deliberately ambiguous, so no one knew his real intention.
